author: Valve
source: Native CS2 Dust II resources, downloaded anonymously with DepotDownloader 3.4.0; decoded with Source2Viewer 20.0.6980

cubemapFog.source: Named env_sky with native HDR cube and material exposure

runtime.conversion: Native 2048x1024 linear EXR resized to 1024x512 RGBE HDR with scripts/prepare-dust2-sky.py; original exposure retained

adaptation.sunIntensity: 2.5 * pi to account for Three.js Lambert diffuse normalization
adaptation.mapLighting: Native 8.2 BC6H irradiance, BC7 sun occlusion and BC1 directional response; see lighting/source.json
adaptation.toneMapping: Native vpost coefficients and linear white point, with native 2.8 pre-curve scale applied to scene and white; fixed linear exposure midpoint 1.0125 (.925..1.1), native 32-cubed LUT. Automatic eye adaptation remains unimplemented.
adaptation.ctRampLight: Bounded 22-intensity point at native fixture position, 8 m radius, decay 1.5
adaptation.sky: Unmodified native 512 BC6H cube and authored mips; legacy HDR retained for IBL and unsupported compression fallback
adaptation.fog: Native 8.2 cubemap distance/height product before tonemapping, reusing the existing sky cube; legacy generic fog on unsupported compression
adaptation.localReflections: Material yaw pi accounts for the VRF panorama +X/u=0 convention; original preview rotation/intensity restored on detach

limitations: Source local barn lights remain bounded point approximations without additional shadow passes.

Material families, native probe octree, reflection blending, adaptive exposure, effect-specific fog, bloom and screen-space occlusion retain approximations; this is not verified one-to-one renderer parity.
Native atlases use authored 4096 mips to bound GPU memory; unsupported compression uses 2048 WebP atlases and the legacy HDR sky.
The extraction-version VRF renderer and newer VRF renderer differ in white-point interpretation; see docs/dust2-lighting.md.
